tables.name: users
tables.createSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
      user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      username VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      password VARCHAR(255),
      password_version INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      email VARCHAR(255),
      expiry TIMESTAMPTZ,
      token VARCHAR(255),
      updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      is_deleted BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
      imap_uid_validity BIGINT,
      auth_sub TEXT UNIQUE
    )

tables.name: sessions
tables.createSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
      session_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
      session_user_id UUID NOT NULL,
      session_username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      session_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      session_is_read_only BOOLEAN,
      session_authenticated_as VARCHAR(255),
      session_password_version INTEGER,
      auth_sid TEXT,
      auth_refresh_token TEXT,
      auth_recheck_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
      cookie_original_max_age BIGINT,
      cookie_max_age BIGINT,
      cookie_signed BOOLEAN,
      cookie_expires TIMESTAMPTZ,
      cookie_http_only BOOLEAN,
      cookie_path TEXT,
      cookie_domain TEXT,
      cookie_secure VARCHAR(10),
      cookie_same_site VARCHAR(20),
      updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

tables.name: mailboxes
tables.createSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mailboxes (
      mailbox_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
      address VARCHAR(255),
      parent_id UUID REFERENCES mailboxes(mailbox_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      uid_validity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      uid_next INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      subscribed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
      special_use VARCHAR(50),
      created TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
columns: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
UUID REFERENCES mailboxes(mailbox_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: mails
tables.createSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mails (
      mail_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
      user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      message_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL,
      subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      html TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      from_address JSONB,
      from_text TEXT,
      to_address JSONB,
      to_text TEXT,
      cc_address JSONB,
      cc_text TEXT,
      bcc_address JSONB,
      bcc_text TEXT,
      reply_to_address JSONB,
      reply_to_text TEXT,
      envelope_from JSONB,
      envelope_to JSONB,
      attachments JSONB,
      read BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      saved BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      sent BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      deleted BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      draft BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      answered BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      expunged BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      insight JSONB,
      uid_domain INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      modseq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      spam_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      spam_reasons JSONB,
      is_spam BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
      rfc822_size BIGINT,
      text_line_count INTEGER,
      html_line_count INTEGER,
      in_reply_to VARCHAR(512),
      reference_ids JSONB,
      ingested TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      search_vector TSVECTOR,
      UNIQUE (user_id, message_id)
    )
columns: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

searchVectorDdl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mails_search_vector_trigger() RETURNS trigger AS $$
      BEGIN
        NEW.search_vector := to_tsvector('english',
        coalesce(replace(replace(NEW.subject,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(NEW.text, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(NEW.from_text, '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(NEW.to_text,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '')
      );
        RETURN NEW;
      END
      $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS mails_search_update ON mails
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS mails_search_insert ON mails

CREATE TRIGGER mails_search_insert
        BEFORE INSERT ON mails
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mails_search_vector_trigger()

CREATE TRIGGER mails_search_update
        BEFORE UPDATE OF subject, text, from_text, to_text ON mails
        FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mails_search_vector_trigger()

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_mails_thread_subject_key
  ON mails (user_id, (md5(lower(btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(subject, '^\s*((re|fwd?|aw|wg|sv|vs|antw|tr|rv)\s*(\[\d+\])?\s*[:：]\s*)+', '', 'i'), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))))))
  WHERE in_reply_to IS NULL AND reference_ids IS NULL

statements.name: search_vector reindex
statements.sql:
UPDATE mails
      SET search_vector = to_tsvector('english',
        coalesce(replace(replace(subject,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(text, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(from_text, '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(to_text,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '')
      )
      WHERE mail_id IN (
        SELECT mail_id
        FROM mails
        WHERE search_vector IS DISTINCT FROM to_tsvector('english',
        coalesce(replace(replace(subject,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(text, '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(from_text, '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '') || ' ' ||
        coalesce(replace(replace(to_text,   '<', ' '), '>', ' '), '')
      )
        LIMIT 1000
      )
